messages:
elaine-sales: Sheridan bank got back with the SIG upload portal link. They want per-question artifacts and requested evidence IDs in the CSV. They emphasized KMS rotation, private VPC networking, and DB encryption envelope. Who can own what?

mike-se: I'll take DB encryption (ARNs + snippet) and pricing artifacts. Sam, can you handle KMS rotation and key policies?

sam-security: Yep. Plan: 1) short narrative for SIG Q3.2.1 stating AES-256-GCM, customer CMK supported, rotation enabled; 2) rotation command screenshot; 3) rotation SOP. Also will include CloudTrail KMS logs snippet.

zoe-ps: I'll produce the VPC diagram and a minimal firewall ruleset example for their portal. Also will call out Dedicated deployment network isolation model for POC.

elaine-sales: Good. Sheridan also asked whether redwood supports BYOK HSM-backed keys. We support KMS HSM when customer brings keys? Need exact phrasing.

mike-se: We support customer-managed keys via AWS KMS & GCP KMS. For HSM-backed keys, we can say "BYOK via cloud KMS with HSM-backed CMKs where supported by the cloud provider." Sam, confirm?

sam-security: Confirmed. We'll phrase it: "Redwood supports customer-managed keys through cloud KMS providers (AWS KMS, GCP KMS); if the customer configures HSM-backed CMKs at the provider, those keys can be used for encryption of at-rest storage and database envelope keys."

infra-bot: Artifact uploaded: /artifacts/sheridan/SIG/2025-11-22/vpc-diagram-poc.png (uploaded by zoe-ps) :white_check_mark:

mike-se: DB ARN: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345-6789. Will add to `SIG-DB-ARN-2025-11-22.txt` artifact.

elaine-sales: Also add a short note about access controls for the DB keys (IAM roles, least-privilege). Sheridan's portal asks for who can perform key rotation.

sam-security: We'll list ops/security team roles and include IAM policy example. Example policy snippet:```{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{
    "Effect": "Allow",
    "Action": ["kms:RotateKey", "kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion"],
    "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:..."
  }]
}```

mike-se: Uploading pricing quote now.

elaine-sales: ETA for full CSV import-ready package?

zoe-ps: End of day tomorrow if no blockers.

sam-security: Same EOD tomorrow. I'll mark any high-risk items.

infra-bot: Artifact uploaded: /artifacts/sheridan/SIG/2025-11-22/DB-ARN.txt (uploaded by mike-se) :white_check_mark:

elaine-sales: Great. I'll send an update to Sheridan with expected delivery and include temporary filenames. Thanks team. :rocket:
